title: composite-regression-sentinel-harness-for-ci-gating
creator: Aisha Kumar
description: Build a composite regression sentinel that combines multiple lightweight microbenchmarks, traffic-shaped replay traces, and slice-aware statistical detectors to provide robust PR gating for tokens/sec and latency p95 regressions. The goal is lower false positives than single-metric guards while remaining fast enough to run in the CI window for PRs. The harness will produce per-model and per-slice baselines, run an ensemble of detectors (bootstrap CI, Bayesian change point, and a trimmed-mean z-score detector), and output a single gate decision with annotated rationale and suggested remediation pointers. This ticket covers design, prototype impl, CI integration, and rollout plan for ~6k PRs/month gating across hosted/dedicated model variants.
acceptance_criteria: CI job executes composite sentinel within 22 minutes median on our small runner fleet
False positive rate <= 1.5% on historical PR corpus (rolling 90d) when tuned to p95 tokens/sec and 95th-latency slice targets
Detected regressions include the root cause trace in the CI artifact with: failing slice, detector(s) tripped, and delta vs baseline
Gate decision exposed via GitHub check with clear pass/fail and link to detailed dashboard and replay artifacts
Configurable per-repo per-model thresholds and an opt-in 'experimental strict' mode for core infra repos
implementation_steps: Design composite signal (microbenchmarks + replay + slice-aware detectors) and finalize metrics schema
Implement microbench harness runner that executes lightweight tokens/sec probes across seq-length bins
Add traffic-shaped replay runner using anonymized recent production traces and prefix caching stubs
Implement ensemble detectors: bootstrap CI, Bayesian posterior change detection, and trimmed-mean z-score
Create baseline service to store per-model/per-slice rolling baselines and exposure via API
Integrate with CI: add pipeline job, artifacts uploader, and GitHub Check API integration
Build gating policy engine to translate detector outputs into pass/fail + rationale text
Add dashboarding (Grafana) and PR annotations + auto-linking to related incident/PRs
Run shadow for 2 weeks on 1% of PRs, evaluate FPR/FNR, tune detector thresholds, then enable opt-in gating
Roll out gradual enforcement with kill-switch and automatic fallback to baseline model variants
notes: 2025-02-11: Kickoff design meeting with infra, runtime, and DX teams. Agreed on per-sequence-length slices (16/64/256/1024) and separate baselines for quantized vs fp16 models. - Aisha

2025-02-18: Prototype microbench runner implemented. Early trade-off: synthetic microbench is fast but misses cache behavior; decided to pair with short replay traces to cover cache/KV effects. - Daniel

2025-02-24: Selected statistical detectors after spike testing. Bayesian detector best at early drift detection; trimmed-mean z-score robust to outliers in noisy traces. Will run all three and weight signals. - Priya Shah

2025-03-01: CI pipeline job added to runners. End-to-end median runtime ~20m on small runner group. Observed 3x slower on cold runners; added warmup step and pinned runner type in CI config. - Luca Romano

2025-03-03: Shadow run started on 0.5% of PRs. Initial false positive rate ~2.4% due to a noisy embedder model; added model-specific noise floor in baseline service. Next checkpoint after 2 weeks. - Morgan Lee
blockers: Need small-runner pool autoscaling fix (ENG-41211) to guarantee median job runtime
Privacy review for production trace replay stubbing needs completion (security gating)
resolution_history: 2025-03-04: Decided to store baselines as quantile sketches (t-digest) to support memory-efficient per-slice stats and fast delta computation
2025-03-04: Opted against heavy-weight full production replay for CI due to cost; instead use short prefix replays with KV-cache stubs that emulate cache hit ratios
